complexDefinition.stringValue: To or at a distance from a particular place, person, or thing.

definition.stringValue: To a distance from a place or thing.

text.stringValue: На расстоянии от места или вещи.
She walked **away** from the crowd.
They sailed **away** towards the horizon.
He drove his car **away** from the city.

complexDefinition.stringValue: From one's possession or use.

text.stringValue: Из чьего-либо владения.
She gave **away** her favorite book.
They threw **away** their old toys.
I donated most of my clothes **away**.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Into a suitable state for use.

text.stringValue: Готов к использованию.
The sandwiches are **away** for the picnic.
My presentation slides are **away** for tomorrow's meeting.
The outfits are **away** for today's photoshoot.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Continually (used to emphasize a duration of time).

text.stringValue: На некоторый промежуток времени.
She will be **away** for two weeks on vacation.
John is studying **away** until his exams are finished.
I've been working **away** on this project for months now.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Into nonexistence or oblivion.

text.stringValue: В небытие.
The disease gradually faded **away**.
Blew the smoke **away**.
Quietly, she slipped **away**.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Absent from a place.

text.stringValue: Не присутствует на месте.
**Away** on a business trip, she missed her son's birthday.
John has been **away** at college since September.
She stepped **away** from the group to make a phone call.

complexDefinition.stringValue: In a different direction.

text.stringValue: По-другому.
**Away**, he gestured towards the chair.
She looked **away**, masking her feelings.
He turned **away**, hiding his tears.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Into a storage place or safekeeping.

text.stringValue: Хранимый или сохраненный в безопасности.
She carefully tucked the heirloom **away**.
He locked the documents **away** in a safe.
I hid my savings **away** for emergencies.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Into action or competition.

text.stringValue: В действие или соревнование.
And they're **away**, shooting off the starting line!
The soccer match kicked off, teams fought **away** fiercely.
As the bell rang, the boxers went **away**, sparring immediately.

complexDefinition.stringValue: So as to remove or get rid of.

text.stringValue: Удаление или избавление от.
She wiped **away** the tears trickling down her face.
The wind blew the dust **away** from the sidewalk.
He quietly slipped **away** from the noisy party.

complexDefinition.stringValue: As measured in a particular direction.

definition.stringValue: At a certain level of progress.

text.stringValue: На определенном уровне прогресса.
She's **away** ahead in her studies.
The team is **away** better than last season.
He is just one step **away** from finishing his project.

complexDefinition.stringValue: In a different place.

text.stringValue: Где-то еще.
He took his children **away** for the weekend.
I need to get **away** from the city.
The bird flew **away** into the horizon.

complexDefinition.stringValue: At an angle.

text.stringValue: Под углом.
Turn **away** when sneezing to avoid spreading germs.
He looked **away** as he lied about his whereabouts.
She quickly glanced **away** to hide her tears.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To or at a certain degree of progress or development.

definition.stringValue: At a certain level of development.

text.stringValue: На определенном уровне развития.
My fitness level is only weeks **away**.
That technology is still years **away**.
Your painting skills are quite a ways **away**.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Through to the end.

text.stringValue: До конца.
Keep **away** until the end of the path.
He worked **away** until the task was finished.
We sang **away** until the sun set.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Freely or openly.

text.stringValue: Свободно или без ограничений.
She danced **away** with joy and excitement.
He laughed **away**, uninhibited by societal norms.
The children played **away** without a care in the world.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Indicating the performer of an action.

definition.stringValue: Indicating who is doing an action.

text.stringValue: Обозначение того, кто совершает действие.
**Away**, John kicked the ball into the goal.
**Away**, she whisked the crumbs from the tablecloth.
Singing and laughing, they danced the night **away**.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To the condition of unconsciousness or death.

definition.stringValue: To a state of death or unconsciousness.

text.stringValue: К состоянию смерти или бессознательности.
The old man quietly faded **away** in his sleep.
Unfortunately, his beloved dog passed **away** last week.
Suddenly, she fainted and slipped **away** into unconsciousness.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To a player's advantage or score in a game.

definition.stringValue: In favor of a player in a game.

text.stringValue: В пользу игрока в игре.
The crowd roared, cheer going **away** for the home team.
The game seemed clearly swinging **away** Joe's favor.
The referee made a decision **away** towards Team A.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To an outlying area.

definition.stringValue: To a place away from the center.

text.stringValue: В место, удаленное от центра.
She walked **away** not looking back at the city center.
He ran **away** from the central market.
Children were playing **away** from the playground center.

complexDefinition.stringValue: So as to hit, strike, or move something (used in describing the sudden occurrence of an event or a process).

definition.stringValue: To hit or move something suddenly.

text.stringValue: Ударить или внезапно подвинуть что-то.
He **away** kicked the ball angrily.
The car sped **away** abruptly.
She flicked the insect **away** in disgust.

complexDefinition.stringValue: From or to a distance.

text.stringValue: На большое расстояние.
He moved **away** from his hometown.
The island is many miles **away**.
She lives **away** in the countryside.
